steps.content: "Leaving the dark swamp behind, you're finally greeted by warm sunshine."
"But the adventurers know that such sunshine won't last for long. The forces of darkness have been haunting the sun, preventing it from fully shining upon this land."
"You must find a way to the castle while the sun is still up."
"At this moment, Hella the knowledgeable Rogue comes up with an idea."
After you break out of the MBCC, the group follows your lead to an area straddling Syndicate and Eastside.
You finish your lines eloquently, passing the ball to Hella.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh...? Ah, yes! We're now at the boundary between the east and west sides of the world.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The sun sets in the west, so the west always gets a bit more sunlight.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: This sunshine has... uh... ruptured... oh oh, I mean nurtured, nurtured a bazaar of everything!
Even though she almost bit her tongue, Hella manages to spit out all the necessary information.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: So the settlement we saw is actually a bazaar... Perfect! A bustling bazaar like this is a treasure trove of information. I'll definitely find some clues.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Even if we can't find anything... we can set up a stall to gather information.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Set up a stall?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Yup. We can set up a little market stall to trade information and items in exchange for what we want.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: But all we have is a bag of brown bread, not much to offer...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Mm-mm. A little stall like ours must rely on luck and the art of conversation.
Etti blinks and points to her head.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh, I get it! We trick them into giving us stuff for free! I know how to do that! Let's tend the stall together! 70% for you and 30% for me!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Hmm... I'll consider it.
As a reminder, I will terminate the game if you violate the rules.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ugh... what a fuddy-duddy!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Let's tend the stall secretly and not tell him!
steps.female_content: Let's tend the stall secretly and not tell her!

steps.content: "Ever since the darkness started eroding the sun, sunset has been arriving earlier with each passing day. The clock is ticking, and before the adventurers get any better ideas, the sky has begun to darken."
"The merchants light up their shops and stalls, seizing the last bit of time to sell before closing for the night."

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh? This quick?! Hey, are you doing this on purpose?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: ...The God of Fate really knows how to screw us over.
"Fate always likes to play tricks on people."
You shrug under Etti's displeased gaze.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Oh well. You already said the sun will set earlier, so I'll accept this. It's dark already, so it's too late.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: In any case, it's our first time at this bazaar, and there's a lot we're unfamiliar with. It might not be useful to set up a stall so quickly anyways.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Let's just take a look around today. We'll set up the stall tomorrow if need be.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: But it's dark now. It might be dangerous to just brashly barge into the bazaar. I want to scout the situation inside first.
Etti motions for you to bring over the dice.
Etti puts the dice in her hands, shakes them gently, then casts them in your direction.
You reach out to catch the dice. When you look down at your palms—it's a critical success.
"Etti the Mage jumps onto a building next to the alley to get a bird's-eye view of the whole bazaar."
"As she expected, the bazaar is a den of chaos. The people rushing to and fro are all quite mysterious. She can tell that most of them are just here to eke out a living."
"They aren't threats to us, but probably won't have any useful information."

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: "They aren't threats to us." Affirmative. But "probably won't have any useful information" means there's still a possibility.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Well... since "fate" didn't shut me down, that means... we can safely go in for a look.
After thinking for a moment, Etti leads Hella and Ninety-Nine into the alley.
The alley is completely empty, but Etti scrutinizes each and every intersection with extreme care. Even Hella can't help but mimic her and look left and right.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Let's see, what shops are around here?
"The most common shops at the bazaar are those selling food and potions, such as brown bread made from easily-grown brown rice, and healing potions with a dash of magic."
"There are also a few mysterious-looking shops scattered in the depths of the bazaar."

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I'm curious about that shop to the right. It has a blue sofa in front of it.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Shall we go over and take a look?
Holding onto a sign on the wall with one hand, Etti stands on her tiptoes on the stone pillar as she calls out to you below.
You raise your head and take over the dialogue.
"As the adventurers look for shops that might offer some clues, they hear a voice in the alley."
You slip your hand into your pocket and gently press the comms device in there twice.
After some clangs and gasps from a nearby alley, you finally hear a female voice.
Oh! My lost little lambs, what do you seek?
Oh, just look at your timid and piteous little eyes!!
Why don't you come serve me—the great, noble, and powerful West District Overlord, EMP. Perhaps I can help guide your fate...
The familiar voice stutters at first, but becomes smooth and eloquent as time goes on. Everyone can tell what she's doing.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Pfft... I'm a hundred percent sure she added those lines herself. What nonsense...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Oh? The West District Overlord? How interesting... I wasn't expecting to gain anything today, but...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: It seems that fate has pointed out a fairly obvious route for us.
Etti leaps forth and lands beside you with a faint smile.
"Although the adventurers are bit wary of this voice, the important thing right now is to gather clues. Hence they decide to go meet the West District Overlord."
You turn away your face somewhat nervously and nudge Hella and Ninety-Nine, who are behind Etti.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hmph! So what if she's the West District Overlord? She's probably nowhere near as smart, witty or lovely as Hella.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't worry, Mage Etti! Go exchange info with her if you wish! I've got you covered!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Ha! You've got her covered? Can you even jump high enough to touch her staff?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hmph! Is your IQ number even as big as her shoe size?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: How dare you!!
A gust of wind blows by. The "West District Overlord" had emerged from the alley, making her grand debut before you.
Like Hella, her face is brimming with delusions of grandeur.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Listen up, dwarf! I have clues about the legendary castle!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: This is a priceless clue that even money can't buy! Prostrate before me if you want it!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Your clue is about the legendary castle?
Upon hearing EMP's words, Etti steps in front of Hella and stares at EMP.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Y-yes. Why? Are you interested?
EMP gulps and shoots a nervous glance at you.
You make a fist to encourage her.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Well, young lady, I see from your eyes how deft and determined you are. I can tell that you have great talent. Want to strike a deal with me and become my sworn sister?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Me? How did you realize that I'm the most perfect Mage in the world who wields unparalleled control over fate and destiny?
EMP freezes, at a loss for words.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Well... I didn't realize that actually...

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Really?! You didn't??
Etti fixes her gaze on EMP, as if EMP is about to say something critical.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Am I... supposed to?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Prepare for battle, my friends.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Haha, yessir!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: All right. Who shall we attack?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: This Syndicate swindler in front of us, of course!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: How dare you play such tricks right under my nose... You actually have no idea whether the clue in your hands is real or not!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Wh-what?
"Etti the Mage thinks that EMP the West District Overlord is not sincere in working with her and is full of lies, so she decides to attack."

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: I was not asking to work together with her!
"Thoroughly intimidated by Etti's presence, EMP skips for one turn."

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Huh?! Isn't that cheating?!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: It's fate, my dear.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Ninety-Nine! Use your berserk skill!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Now, hehe... Hella, you can start putting your thieving skills to good use. Go get us some clues.
Etti finishes prepping all the skills, brings you to the middle, and casts the dice.
The dice roll gently on the ground and stop on the number 1.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: ...A-a-a critical failure?! Hahaha...
"Uh... uh... Ninety-Nine the Barbarian attacks EMP viciously, but EMP manages to dodge her huge sword!"
"Plus, EMP uses the rebound force from the giant sword to attack everyone in the adventurers' team—her real identity is a Bard!"
EMP takes out her bow and arrow and leans forward in a horse stance. She points her bow to the sky, shouting—

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: You... you forced me to do this!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Tsk, quite the troublemaker, isn't she?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: If you don't want to die here, get as close to me as possible!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I'm going to cast a defensive spell!
Too bad the God of Fate didn't take Etti's side this time. The group falls into silence after seeing the number on the dice.
"E...EMP unleashes a hail of arrows, p-piercing through Mage Etti's defensive spell..."
"Even though EMP the West District Overlord loses her ability to move, the adventurers are also forced to halt their quest because of their heavy injuries..."
The dice hit the ground heavily. EMP's legs go limp and slumps to the ground when she sees the number on it.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: It's a... critical success! P-please have mercy... At the very least, s-spare the face!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Taste my boiling rage!
A flash of red dashes by. Wielding her blade, Ninety-Nine appears behind EMP.
But EMP doesn't get completely defeated just yet!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: She dodged the attack!
"Having acquired excellent dodging skills from her years surviving in the West District, EMP manages to escape Ninety-Nine's fatal strike!"

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Etti, watch out! She's coming for you!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Hahaha! Messenger of the dragons my butt! Taste my triple-stacked flash arrow! Pew pew pew pew pew!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You Syndicate swindler! Who puts all the points into dexterity just to dodge attacks?!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Etti, watch out!
Wielding her water pipe, Hella steps in front of Etti to protect her.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Mages shouldn't get involved in melee combat! Watch me destroy your flash arrows!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: H-Hella?
The light from the flash arrows suddenly becomes blindingly bright. Everyone can't help but cover their eyes.
When the light subsides, you see Etti and Hella standing side by side. Perched on Hella's nose is a pair of oversized sunglasses.
You recognize them as the pair she got from the staff when she left the interrogation room.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Where... where did those sunglasses come from?!

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: It's a treasure from my vault—my Dark Abyss Conjoined Lenses!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: They're sunglasses.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Dark Abyss Conjoined Lenses.
"Because Etti swiftly gives Hella a pair of sunglasses..."

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Dark Abyss Conjoined Lenses!
"...Dark Abyss Conjoined Lenses, Hella the Rogue not only dodged EMP the Bard's attack, but also used the lenses' reflection to destroy EMP's remaining stamina!"

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Huh?! I'm gone, just like that?! I still have a lot of lines left...
Huh?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Ah... never mind, never mind. Cough cough...
EMP holds her forehead dramatically, spins on the spot, then kneels onto the ground.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: As I meet my demise... I want to ask you...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Mage Etti, how on earth did you know... that I didn't know if the clue was real or not...?
Etti adjusts her hat and vest, clears her throat, and walks back and forth in front of EMP.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Your acting was 99% perfect, but... that missing 1% gave it away.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: You refused to hand over the clue to me directly, meaning that you didn't acknowledge that I'm the most perfect Mage in the world who wields unparalleled control over fate and destiny.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: In other words, you had no idea whether the clue was real or fake. You just wanted someone to help you identify its authenticity for free.
After finishing her speech, Etti looks back confidently and flashes EMP a haughty smile.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: S-so... that's why! I-I was too weak!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: B-but, I really do have a clue about the castle!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: I'd like to offer it to you for free! B-but... will you let me join your adventure squad?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But aren't you dead...?
<i>"Um... When EMP the Bard was choosing her skills, she chose one that "automatically recovers 1 HP after being severely injured, but can only be used once every fifty turns."</i >

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: That's such a stretch of a skill... Has it been fifty turns already?
Ahem, the game master says it is so, therefore it must be so.
"But whether or not to let her join the adventurer's team is up to you three. Please discuss it carefully."

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Aghhhh, these skills are so complicated! I-I don't care anymore! Just let Etti decide!

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Yeah, let Etti decide.
Befuddled by EMP's complicated skills, Hella shrugs off all responsibility and pulls Ninety-Nine aside to sit down.
Now solely in charge of the decision, Etti smiles smugly with a hand on her hip.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: Of course you're welcome to join. But...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: B-but what?

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: You must give us the clue for free, and... tell us when, where, and how you got it!
EMP nods immediately, sits down on the ground, and explains in detail how she got her clue.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: I knew it! It's the shop with the blue sofa to the right! I could tell at first sight that it's no ordinary shop.

steps.speaker: Etti
steps.content: With that being the case, let's head out now! The sooner we find more clues and reach the castle, the sooner we can get rid of the darkness!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: I agree!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Mhmm, how can I miss out on saving the world? Right, Ninety-nine?

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Mmm, that's right.
"Having added a new member to the team, the adventurers set off to find the merchant who sold EMP her clue."

"They march forward fearlessly in the darkness of night, unafraid of what lies ahead, be it danger or deceit... I'm sure they'll overcome all hardships, grasp the direction of fate, and bring light back to this world... .”
